title: Decomposing Behavioral Phase Transitions in LLMs: Order Parameters for Emergent Misalignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to 100 socio-political questions using an LLM judge to classify the generated stance as 'republican', 'democrat', or 'neutral' (defined as an Order Parameter) across different checkpoints during the fine-tuning process.

Evaluating model responses to 100 geopolitical questions concerning the US and China using an LLM judge to classify the generated stance as 'pro-china', 'pro-usa', or 'neutral' across different fine-tuning checkpoints to track behavioral phase transitions.
